definition.name: Actual accepted Go work SIGTERM retirement and fresh restart

steps.name: Retain original limits and reject false barriers and substituted products
Authenticate the completed exact producer before restoring any executable
Restore only the authenticated public normal Go products
Install the existing network-denied compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the exact maintained Go compiler and generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo install --git https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go --rev 148dba505f8c6c64ad84db777cfde5e34e25098b --locked componentize-go
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.3.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "65efbc80fdc1fa2cd2631cad5b481777a68e8725f34e89f50fc6ac714e379b40  $RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools/go.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools"
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools/go" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools/go-async"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-tools/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Compile one actual v5 fixture and require live accepted ownership before real node stop
Retain bounded source build audit and real shutdown evidence including failures

with.name: go-node-stop-reference-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop-producer.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/pending/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/pending/controls/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/drain/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-node-stop/drain/controls/*.json

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
